app.name: Vital
app.tagline: Lab results, body composition and physical progress.

actions.loginWithProvider: Sign in with your identity provider

auth.name: Name
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in.
auth.oidcHint: This instance authenticates through an identity provider.

sex.label: Sex
sex.why: Sets the reference ranges and the clinical bands.

dashboard.title: Home
dashboard.emptyDescription: Record your first collection to see trends and reference ranges.

biomarker.emptyDescription: It shows up here as soon as you record a collection that includes it.
biomarker.unconvertedPoints: {{count}} value left off the chart: its unit has no known conversion to {{unit}}.
biomarker.unconvertedPoints_other: {{count}} values left off the chart: their unit has no known conversion to {{unit}}.

reports.title: Lab reports
reports.emptyDescription: Record your first lab report to start seeing trends.
reports.refHint: As printed on the report. Left blank, the catalogue range is used.
reports.collectedTimeHint: Local time printed on the report. Matters for markers that vary through the day.
reports.methodHint: e.g. hexokinase, enzymatic, CMIA. Lets a change of method between draws be spotted.

extraction.title: Import a PDF
extraction.description: The model reads the report; you confirm what gets stored.
extraction.pickHint: Text reports or scans. Nothing is stored until you confirm it.
extraction.reading: Reading the report. This can take up to a minute.
extraction.checkHint: Check every line against the report before saving. Correct what is wrong and remove what you do not want.
extraction.unmatched: {{count}} line does not match any biomarker in the catalogue — pick one or remove it.
extraction.unmatched_other: {{count}} lines do not match any biomarker in the catalogue — pick one or remove them.
extraction.pickAtLeastOne: Pick at least one biomarker with a value.

interventions.title: Interventions
interventions.name: Name
interventions.emptyDescription: Record supplements, diet or training to see them overlaid on the charts.

body.title: Body composition
body.trendOnlyHint: Recorded as a trend. There is no validated clinical standard for this estimate.
body.emptyDescription: Record your first weigh-in to see the trend and the clinical bands.
body.setSexTitle: Set your sex in the profile
body.setSexDescription: Clinical bands differ between men and women — without it, values cannot be classified.
body.estimateWarning: Bioimpedance figures are estimates. The trend is the reliable signal, not the isolated value.
body.atLeastOneValue: Fill in at least one value.

photos.title: Progress photos
photos.privacyNote: Photos stay on this instance and are stored without metadata: the location, the camera model and the capture time do not survive the upload.
photos.emptyDescription: Take the first photo so there is something to compare against later.
photos.compareNeedsTwoDescription: At least two photos of this pose are needed.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.sexNote: Changing the sex re-classifies the whole history.

chart.trendSummary: Trend chart for {{name}}: {{count}} values, from {{first}} {{unit}} on {{firstDate}} to {{last}} {{unit}} on {{lastDate}}.

caveats.unknown: This value carries a caveat this version of the app cannot interpret.
caveats.fasting_unknown: Nobody recorded whether this draw was fasted, and this marker is sensitive to it.
caveats.not_fasting: Drawn without fasting: this marker is sensitive to the last meal.
caveats.fasting_too_short: Fasted {{hours}} h, under the {{required}} h this marker asks for.
caveats.collection_time_unknown: Collection time not recorded. This marker varies through the day and should be drawn between {{start}} and {{end}}.
caveats.outside_time_window: Drawn at {{time}}, outside the {{start}}–{{end}} window recommended for this marker.
caveats.low_reliability_method: Method \u201c{{method}}\u201d: less reliable than the alternatives for this marker. See the biomarker notes.
caveats.method_changed: Different method from the previous draw ({{from}} \u2192 {{to}}): the difference may be the assay rather than the body.
